name: pi
why: pi-claude-bridge 0.12.0 declares it in its peerDependencies.
notes: mise installs it as pi. @earendil-works/pi-ai, also a devDependency for the extensions' types, moves with it. docs/bstack.md, docs/bstack/01-setup.md, docs/development.md and lib/help.sh name the minimum.

name: pi-claude-bridge
notes: An exact pin. Its peerDependencies set pi's minimum. docs/bstack.md, docs/development.md and lib/help.sh name the version.

name: herdr-app
notes: It updates itself. bercail/mods/bercail-spaces and bercail-agents are copies of its mods: they need the Herdr in their mod.json's cloned_from, or newer, and a changed mod upstream means a rebase (docs/development.md).

name: herdr-core
notes: hc: desks, siblings and notify.

name: worktrunk
why: `wt list --format=json` is {schema, items: [...]} from 0.80.0 on; the shell block reads that shape.
notes: The install fallback downloads releases/latest (lib/deps.sh).

name: tuicr
why: q_quits in config/tuicr/config.toml arrived in 0.26.0; older tuicr ignores the key.
notes: tuicr ignores config keys it does not know, so a key bercail ships that needs a newer tuicr fails silently: raise the minimum with it.

name: beads
notes: 1.4.0 migrates the store one way, and 1.3.x cannot read it after: back up the store, migrate it, and bump BD_VERSION in one job. bd's doctor ranks an rc above the final release.

name: entire
why: 0.13.3 keeps capturing a Pi session across /reload, /new and /resume; 0.13.4 stops the pre-push hook panicking in repos with config.worktree.
notes: Nightlies are tagged prerelease. A settings key a newer CLI adds (redaction.drop_images in 0.13.4) makes older CLIs reject .entire/settings.json: commit one only once the minimum has it.

name: entire-brain
why: bercail's guard rules, doctor check and desk steps are tested with 0.5.1.
notes: An Entire plugin (entire plugin upgrade brain).

name: entire-graph
notes: An Entire plugin (entire plugin upgrade graph).

name: tla2tools
notes: TLC, for the statechart skill; installed only with [bstack] statechart = true, through mise's http backend with the jar's sha256. Both pins carry the sha256: move it with the version, and run tests/statechart/shep-inbox/check.sh.

name: java
why: TLC 1.7.4 runs on Java 11 or later.
notes: Only with [bstack] statechart = true: any java of 11 or later on PATH, else mise installs java@temurin-25 (STATECHART_JAVA_SPEC in lib/deps.sh), never as the global java.

name: pstack-statechart
notes: The statechart skill, vendored from cursor/plugins (pstack/skills/statechart, MIT) without upstream's scripts/test. Upstream has no releases: a newer commit is copied in whole, SKILL.upstream.md with it (skills/statechart/UPSTREAM.md).

name: pi-emphasis
notes: Pills and icons in Pi replies, vendored from johnlindquist/pi-emphasis (MIT) byte for byte; every bstack role loads it (lib/bstack.sh:BSTACK_PI_EMPHASIS). Upstream has no releases or tags: a newer commit is copied in whole, after reading its diff (bstack/pi/extensions/pi-emphasis/UPSTREAM.md).

name: jq
notes: Its tags are jq-<version>.

name: fzf
notes: The worktree picker (config/shell/bercail.inc.sh).

name: node
notes: CI takes the newest 26.x (node-version: 26), and docs/development.md asks for Node 26. A new major is a separate move: @types/node follows it.

name: vite-plus
notes: An exact pin, with the vite override in package.json at the same version.

name: bats
notes: An exact pin that follows npm: GitHub has releases npm does not (1.14.0). 1.14.0's run honours set -e in the functions it runs, and an empty suite fails without --allow-empty-suite.

name: wrangler
notes: package.json allows ^4.0.0; the lockfile holds the version. site/wrangler.jsonc's compatibility_date can move with it.

name: astro
notes: package.json allows ^7.4.4; the lockfile holds the version.

name: @types/node
notes: Follows the Node major CI runs.

name: shellcheck
notes: A newer shellcheck warns about more: bump it on its own, with the warnings it finds fixed.

name: jdx/packslip
notes: Signs the release bundle.

name: workers-compatibility-date
notes: No feed: check https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/compatibility-flags/ when wrangler moves.
